projects.title: Virtrolio
projects.description: A web app bringing virtual yearbook signings to the Class of 2020. With COVID-19 leading to lockdowns and social distancing, Virtrolio gives students an alternative way to share end-of-year messages. (Angular/Firebase)

projects.title: Tangible - Universal Touch Screen
projects.description: Hardware accessory to add touchscreen functionality to any monitor using ultrasonic distance sensors and an Arduino microcontroller. Implemented velocity-based scroll gestures and sensor noise reduction for discrete tap detection. (C++)
